# Toolsets

Hermes provides pluggable toolsets that extend what the agent can do.

## Available Toolsets

The default toolsets include file operations, web search, and code execution.
Each toolset can be enabled or disabled in the config file.

### Web Search Toolset

The web search toolset lets the agent query search engines and fetch pages.
Configure it under the `toolsets.web` section of your config file.
